items.question: Within how many days from the date of application must the UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation refer an unresolved individual labour dispute to the competent court?
items.gold: 14 days from the date of application.
items.fact: MOHRE refers unsettled disputes to court within 14 days

items.question: Under the UAE Labour Law, for claims below what amount are workers exempt from judicial fees at all litigation and execution stages?
items.fact: Workers exempt from judicial fees for claims under AED 100,000
